pullRequest.title: fix: preserve non-JSON-serializable storage options in _make_async

issue.title: FsspecStore.from_mapper() fails with DefaultAzureCredential because AzureBlobFileSystem is not JSON serializable
issue.body:
### Zarr version

v3.3.0

### Numcodecs version

v0.6.15

### Python Version

3.12.11

### Operating System

Ubuntu 26.04

### Installation

uv add zarr

### Environment

- Python 3.12.11
- zarr 3.3.0
- xarray 2026.7.0
- fsspec 2026.7.0
- adlfs 2026.5.0
- azure-identity 1.25.3

### Description

Opening an xarray dataset backed by an Azure Blob Storage FSMap created with
DefaultAzureCredential fails because `FsspecStore.from_mapper()` attempts to
serialize the filesystem using `fs.to_json()`.

The embedded `DefaultAzureCredential` is not JSON serializable.

### Steps to reproduce

```python
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.12"
# dependencies = [
#   "zarr@git+https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python.git@main",
# ]
# ///
#
# This script automatically imports the development branch of zarr to check for issues

import zarr
from fsspec import filesystem
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
import xarray as xr

fs = filesystem(
    "az",
    account_name="<account>",
    credential=DefaultAzureCredential(),
)
mapper = fs.get_mapper("container/example.zarr")
xr.open_zarr(mapper)

# zarr.print_debug_info()
```

### Additional output

#### Traceback

`TypeError: Object of type DefaultAzureCredential is not JSON serializable`

##### The traceback ends in

```
FsspecStore.from_mapper(...)
_make_async(...)
fs.to_json()
json.dumps(...)
```
